name: Machinist
description: DEVICE UNDER TEST: MACHINIST — machinist.like.audio, 28 shop tools (the welding suite holding six calculators) behind one React shell: Jo-block stacks, the Hardinge dividing head, speeds and feeds, bolt circles, sine bars, taps and dies, fits and tolerances, hardness and surface finish. Every tool but the dividing head and the screw-head library reads the shared UnitContext, so metric/imperial is one setting for the whole app and not one per panel. The build is root-based (no Vite base), so dist/ runs at the root of a site.
